# logging

OpenShift Logging operator. The loki element adds log storage, the forwarder and the console UI.

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  logging:
    enabled: true
```

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-cluster-logging` | `cluster-logging` | `stable-6.5` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-logging` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `install`

`install-logging-<cluster>`: Policy for any operator installation.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-cluster-logging` | enforce | high | [operator](#operators) `cluster-logging` | Installs the OpenShift logging operator |
